intent: A Kanban board of columns and task cards, not a full project product. Counts are text. Cards move by drag or by keyboard: Space picks a card up, arrows move it, Space drops and Escape cancels. Built on kit Badge, Avatar, Button and Empty.
useWhen: a small board of tasks by status inside a product
let people move cards between columns with mouse or keyboard
show an overflowing column with + N more
doNotUseWhen: a list with filters and sorting — DataTable

cards.note: { id, title, tags?, assignee?: { name, initials?, avatarSrc? }, dueOn? }[]

onCardClick.note: Click or Enter on a card.

requirements: section aria-labelledby the h3 board title; each column is a section named by its heading
cards are buttons in ordered lists, described by the move instructions
Space picks up (aria-pressed), arrows move, Space or Enter drops, Escape cancels; each step is announced in a live region
focus stays on the moved card
counts are text next to each column name
cards fade and rise in after a move and lift on transform; off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local Kanban or BoardColumn
Do not make moves drag-only; keep the keyboard path
Do not encode status by colour alone
snippet: <TaskBoard title="Billing Q4" note="example tasks" columns={columns} cards={cards} onMove={move} onAdd={addCard} onCardClick={openCard} onNewTask={newTask} onFilter={filter} />
